##### Project general facts

Seven Palm is a luxurious beachfront twin-tower development, offering a lifestyle that merges island serenity with cosmopolitan sophistication. Positioned between Dukes The Palm and Fairmont The Palm, this iconic development presents residents with uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf, Dubai Marina skyline, and Burj Al Arab. Comprising two interconnected towers — one residential and one hotel — Seven Palm is crowned by one of the largest rooftop infinity pools in the region, delivering the essence of elegant coastal living.

Residents enjoy a wealth of world-class amenities designed to redefine modern resort living. An Olympic-size rooftop infinity pool offers breathtaking panoramic views, while a state-of-the-art gym, landscaped gardens, direct beach access, and indoor-outdoor dining spaces create a lifestyle of effortless luxury. The project brings together resort-style leisure and city convenience, surrounded by five-star hotels, Nakheel Mall, and vibrant restaurants and cafés.

Every residence at Seven Palm is designed with contemporary elegance and functional comfort, featuring open layouts, natural light, and high-quality finishes. Select penthouses include private pools and rooftop access, elevating the sense of privacy and luxury. Apartments are fully furnished with fully equipped kitchens, and each home is crafted to offer a sanctuary of style and sophistication overlooking the Arabian Gulf.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on the iconic Palm Jumeirah, this exceptional location offers an exclusive lifestyle at the very heart of the Arabian Gulf. The island's unique palm-tree-shaped design features a combination of luxury villas, apartments, and hotels, making it one of Dubai's most prestigious residential and tourist destinations. With its private beaches, ocean views, and proximity to Dubai Marina, the area attracts those seeking a refined coastal lifestyle in an extraordinary architectural setting.

The location is distinguished by its luxurious hospitality options, hosting some of Dubai's most celebrated hotels and resorts such as Atlantis The Palm and One&Only, which add to the island's vibrancy with world-class dining, leisure, and entertainment venues. Residents benefit from premium amenities including private beach access, fitness centers, pools, and retail outlets, creating a comprehensive, self-contained living experience. The island's monorail and well-planned road networks facilitate easy access to other major Dubai neighborhoods while maintaining a serene, resort-like environment.

For those seeking a residence that embodies exclusivity, convenience, and scenic beauty, Palm Jumeirah delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of private beaches, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy a lifestyle that feels worlds away yet is intimately connected to the pulse of the city.
